verdict.rationale: Sketch ships a built-in MCP server enabling AI clients (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to interact with Sketch, and offers AI features (recreating designs from repos, code generation, palette generation, content replacement) that can be invoked via natural-language prompts through those AI clients rather than a native NL command interface within Sketch itself. missing for 10: no evidence of a native in-app natural-language command bar/chat interface, no independent hands-on verification of MCP/AI feature reliability, and no detail on the breadth of commands supported via MCP.
